label: AU-5(2)
title: Real-time Alerts

statement.prose: Provide an alert within {{ insert: param, au-05.02_odp.01 }} to {{ insert: param, au-05.02_odp.02 }} when the following audit failure events occur: {{ insert: param, au-05.02_odp.03 }}.

guidance: Alerts provide organizations with urgent messages. Real-time alerts provide these messages at information technology speed (i.e., the time from event detection to alert occurs in seconds or less).

params.label: real-time period
guidelines: real-time period requiring alerts when audit failure events (defined in AU-05(02)_ODP[03]) occur is defined;

params.label: personnel, roles, and/or locations
guidelines: personnel, roles, and/or locations to be alerted in real time when audit failure events (defined in AU-05(02)_ODP[03]) occur is/are defined;

params.label: audit logging failure events requiring real-time alerts
guidelines: audit logging failure events requiring real-time alerts are defined;
